Disclaimer

General Information

MELABAGAN BANQUETS provides facilities for events such as weddings, receptions, birthdays, corporate gatherings, business meetings, and other social or formal events. By accessing or using our services, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined below.

Booking and Availability

All bookings are subject to availability and are confirmed only after receipt of a signed agreement and applicable advance payment. The management reserves the right to prioritize bookings or deny services in case of any discrepancy, unforeseen circumstances, or non-compliance with the terms and conditions.

Pricing and Payment

Prices for our services and facilities may vary based on requirements, seasonality, and other factors. Any changes to pricing or taxes are at the discretion of MELABAGAN BANQUETS. Payments once made are non-refundable, except in cases explicitly agreed upon in writing by the management.

Event Responsibility

Clients are solely responsible for the planning, organization, and execution of their events within the premises. MELABAGAN BANQUETS shall not be held liable for any personal injury, property damage, theft, or loss of items during the event. Clients must ensure all activities comply with Indian laws, including noise and public safety regulations.

Force Majeure

MELABAGAN BANQUETS shall not be liable for any cancellation, delay, or disruption caused by events beyond our control, such as natural disasters, strikes, governmental restrictions, or other force majeure circumstances.

Third-Party Services

We may recommend or facilitate third-party services (e.g., caterers, decorators, photographers). However, MELABAGAN BANQUETS does not take responsibility for the quality, reliability, or disputes arising from such services. Clients are encouraged to coordinate directly with third-party providers.

Property Damage

Clients are expected to maintain the premises in its original condition. Any damage caused to the property during the event will result in additional charges, determined by the management.
